workstreams.name: Procurement
workstreams.answers: What does Iberia Foods buy, on what terms, and where could purchasing cost fall without affecting service?
activities: Analyze purchasing data by category and supplier
Review supplier contracts and price terms
Interview buyers and production staff on specifications

workstreams.name: Manufacturing
workstreams.answers: What drives production cost per product, and which drivers can change without cutting service levels?
activities: Analyze production cost and yield data by product
Interview line supervisors and operators on cost drivers
Observe production runs to check reported cost data

workstreams.name: Logistics
workstreams.answers: What does moving product to customers cost, and which drivers can change without hurting delivery service?
activities: Analyze shipment and transport cost data by route
Interview transport and delivery staff on constraints
Review customer delivery requirements and contract terms

workstreams.name: Warehousing
workstreams.answers: What does storing and handling product cost, and which drivers can change without hurting order availability?
activities: Analyze storage, handling and inventory cost data
Interview warehouse staff on workflow and bottlenecks
Compare stock levels with order fulfillment records

workstreams.name: Sales and marketing
workstreams.answers: What do sales and marketing cost, and which spend can change without affecting customer service levels?
activities: Analyze sales and marketing spend by channel and activity
Interview sales and marketing staff on how spend is set
Interview customers on what they value in sales support

workstreams.name: Finance
workstreams.answers: What does finance cost, and do savings across all streams add up to 8% of the cost base?
activities: Build a cost base baseline by category and function
Interview finance staff on reporting and approval work
Test savings from all streams against 8% of the cost base

workstreams.name: HR
workstreams.answers: What do HR services and workforce policies cost, and which can change without affecting service levels?
activities: Analyze headcount, absence and overtime data by function
Interview line managers and HR staff on staffing practices
Review HR policies and employment terms

workstreams.name: IT
workstreams.answers: What do IT systems and services cost, and which can change without affecting operations or service levels?
activities: Analyze IT spend, licenses and usage data
Interview system users and IT staff on needs and gaps
Review IT contracts and service agreements

workstreams.name: Legal
workstreams.answers: What do legal services and contract terms cost, and which can change without raising risk or cutting service?
activities: Analyze legal spend by type of work and provider
Interview legal staff and contract owners on workload
Review contract and compliance documents for cost terms

workstreams.name: Customer service
workstreams.answers: What service levels do customers get today, what does delivering them cost, and where are they at risk?
activities: Analyze service level, complaint and contact data
Interview customers on the service levels they rely on
Interview customer service staff on cost and workload

workstreams.name: Pricing
workstreams.answers: Which pricing and discount terms carry cost, and how do they link to the service levels customers get?
activities: Analyze price, discount and margin data by customer
Review customer pricing agreements and price lists
Interview sales and pricing staff on how prices are set

workstreams.name: Real estate
workstreams.answers: What does property cost, and what space do manufacturing and warehousing need to hold service levels?
activities: Analyze property cost, area and utilization data by site
Review lease and ownership documents for cost terms
Interview site and facilities staff on space use

notes: No stream owns the cross-function savings total; Finance carries the test against the 8% target, and the partner may want a separate owner.
